results.change_intent: Prevent large memory allocations in VerifyHashedPasswordV3 by enforcing an upper bound of 8 KiB on the salt length read from the hash header.
results.summary: The change safely caps saltLength to 8 KiB to prevent high memory allocations or OutOfMemoryExceptions from malformed or hostile password hashes.
